text:
Tessa: Invoice INV-2026-0042 for BlueHarbor is overdue by 28 days. ACH attempt failed on 2026-03-10 (txn id: fail_9f3b). Outstanding: $48,750. Need decision: payment plan vs. escalate to collections/legal.
Omar: FYI I just spoke with BlueHarbor CFO — they propose splitting into 3 payments over 60 days. Asked if we can waive late fees if they stick to the plan.
Kelly: Relationship is healthy otherwise, they had an unexpected usage spike. I'm inclined to be flexible. Suggest we require an ACH mandate and put account on restricted provisioning until first payment posts.
Ravi: What's our exposure if they default? Any collateral or credit holds?
Tessa: Quick summary of status:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0042
Amount: $48,750
Issued: 2026-02-05
Due: 2026-03-08
Failed ACH: 2026-03-10 (fail_9f3b)
Requested plan: 3 installments over 60 days
```
Proposed plan: 3 installments — 30% ($14,625) due 2026-04-05, 30% ($14,625) due 2026-05-05, 40% ($19,500) due 2026-06-05. Waive late fees only if first payment clears on time. Restrict new seat provisioning and pause Premier Support until first payment posted.
Omar: BlueHarbor asked for a short written confirmation they can sign. Can you draft? They agreed to ACH pull but want it on file.
Tessa: Drafted note below — please review:
"Hi BlueHarbor team,

Thanks for working with us. Per our conversation, Redwood Inference agrees to the following payment schedule for invoice INV-2026-0042 (total $48,750):
- Payment 1: $14,625 due 2026-04-05 (ACH)
- Payment 2: $14,625 due 2026-05-05 (ACH)
- Payment 3: $19,500 due 2026-06-05 (ACH)

Conditions: 1) First payment must clear by 2026-04-05 or the account will be placed on full suspension and late fees will apply; 2) Late-fee waiver applies only if all scheduled payments clear on the dates above; 3) Account provisioning will remain restricted until the first payment is posted.

Please reply with authorization to pull the first ACH on 2026-04-05 and attach your ACH mandate.

Best,
Tessa (Finance Ops)"
Ravi: Approve with conditions: require signed ACH mandate, set a processing hold if payment fails, and ask Legal to draft a short MOU to attach. No permanent fee waivers — only conditional as written.
Kelly: I'll send this to the customer now and attach a payment schedule PDF. Omar pls confirm after they return the ACH mandate.
Omar: Will follow up — I have the CFO on the line this afternoon. Expect mandate by EOD tomorrow.
collections-bot: Reminder scheduled: Payment 1 (INV-2026-0042) due 2026-04-05. Automated email to customer will go out 2026-03-29.
